infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TravelAssistant uses your location to show nearby places, directions, and emergency services when you ask.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: TravelAssistant can use location for transit reminders after you opt in.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: TravelAssistant uses your camera to scan menus, signs, and labels for translation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: TravelAssistant uses your photo library so you can choose images to translate or share travel spots.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Allow TravelAssistant to turn your speech into travel questions.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow TravelAssistant to use the microphone for voice travel questions.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow TravelAssistant to use your location for nearby places and directions.

plugins.photosPermission: TravelAssistant uses your photos so you can scan menus to translate and share travel spot pictures.
plugins.cameraPermission: TravelAssistant uses your camera to scan menus, signs, and labels for translation, and to add photos of places you’ve visited.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow TravelAssistant to use the microphone for voice travel questions.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow TravelAssistant to turn your speech into travel questions.
